## Which is it?

- [ ] **Module** &mdash; adds something (adventure, setting, adversaries, optional rules, tool)
- [ ] **Core rules change** &mdash; changes the one page

## The compatibility check

- [ ] This works at a table that only knows the one page
- [ ] No existing character sheet becomes wrong because of this
- [ ] Nobody has to re-learn the basics to use it
